name: Pupils
label: Dischord
lede: Half of Lungfish, a voice and a guitar, recorded at home: one Dischord album with songs called Mysterium, Lamb With Human Hands and Witness the Sidewalk Weeping Pools of Martian Brine.

eras.title: Lungfish, down to two
eras.text: By 2000 Lungfish had spent more than a decade as Baltimore's most singular Dischord band. Singer Daniel Higgs and guitarist Asa Osborne, who had played together since before Lungfish existed, split off as Pupils to hear the songs with nothing else in the room.

years.h: Daniel Higgs and Asa Osborne start Pupils, outside Lungfish
years.p: Dischord dates Pupils' start to late 2000 or early 2001: [[Daniel Higgs|6dd4abcc-0321-4ac0-b3bf-0a9422c450d9]] on vocals and guitar, [[Asa Osborne|4314be59-8f9c-453b-a2bc-7ca086d36a10]] on guitar. Both stay in Lungfish the whole time.
years.xp:
Higgs and Osborne go back further than Lungfish: they had played together in Reptile House, a Baltimore band that lasted only a handful of shows, before Higgs' poetry readings grew into Lungfish.

Without Lungfish's bass and drums, Pupils was Higgs' voice and words over Osborne's guitar, nothing to hide behind.

years.p: Dischord says Pupils, the duo of Daniel Higgs and Asa Osborne, played their first public performance in May 2001, a few months after starting to work together.

eras.title: Twelve songs from the house
eras.text: Pupils made exactly one record. It was cut at home rather than in a studio, mixed with Chad Clark of Beauty Pill, and given a Dischord catalog number between Lungfish albums.

years.h: Pupils, the duo's only album · Dischord No. 131
years.p: Twelve songs recorded, per the credits, "At Home," with Daniel Higgs on vocals and Asa Osborne on guitar. Titles include It's Good to Have Met You, The Mind Is a Hole in the Body and Go to Gone.
years.xp:
The home recordings were mixed by the band and [[Chad Clark|f3f09e99-e31c-4aa2-99e4-0b4e59e72f87]] of [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]] at Silver Sonya, the D.C. studio. Track nine is simply listed as untitled; track ten is called Jesus Christ.

Dischord calls Pupils the duo's first full-length record. There was never a second.

years.p: Dischord lists Pupils as active 2000–2002. No breakup, no statement: Daniel Higgs and Asa Osborne simply carried on in Lungfish.

eras.title: Back to the big band, then out on their own
eras.text: After Pupils, Daniel Higgs and Asa Osborne went back to Lungfish for its last two albums. When Lungfish went quiet, both went solo, and the Pupils name came back once more for an art show in New York.

years.h: Higgs and Osborne back in Lungfish: Love Is Love
years.p: The next Dischord record by Daniel Higgs and Asa Osborne is Lungfish's Love Is Love, Dischord No. 137.

years.h: Lungfish's Feral Hymns, and the long silence
years.p: Lungfish's last album, recorded in California with [[Tim Green|19b6bda7-fbb1-4a45-a3c7-687114167e8c]]. The band never announces an ending; Dischord describes it as quasi, if not entirely, defunct.
The first of a run of Daniel Higgs solo records. Dischord notes that Asa Osborne performs solo too, as The Zomes.

years.cap: Pupils (Daniel Higgs & Asa Osborne), Mountain Fold Gallery, New York, 2008
years.h: Pupils art show at Mountain Fold Gallery, New York
years.p: Dischord announces a show of Daniel Higgs' and Asa Osborne's artwork under the Pupils name at Mountain Fold Gallery in New York, opening Friday, March 14, 7 to 9 p.m., and running through April 26.
years.xp: Higgs and Osborne were visual artists as much as musicians. Higgs had worked as a tattoo artist in Baltimore, and Osborne moved art for a living during the Lungfish years.
